channel.title: Powernux blog
channel.description: Linux productivity guides and Powernux news.

item.title: A Pomodoro timer and focus mode built into your Linux desktop
item.description: Focus sessions and Pomodoro on Linux: open your work apps, mute notifications, block distracting apps and track your day in an elegant notch.

item.title: Voice typing on Linux: dictate anywhere with Whisper, Groq or AssemblyAI
item.description: Push-to-talk dictation for Linux: hold a key, speak, release — your words are transcribed with Whisper (Groq, OpenAI) or AssemblyAI and pasted into any app.

item.title: How to keep a window always on top in GNOME on Wayland
item.description: Pin any window above the others in GNOME on Wayland with a keyboard shortcut and a visible border — plus auto-layouts and workspaces you restore in one shortcut.

item.title: The best way to get clipboard history on Linux (GNOME, Wayland)
item.description: How to get a Windows-like clipboard history (Win + V) on Linux with GNOME and Wayland — pinning, search, and automatic protection for passwords.

item.title: Introducing Powernux: a modular productivity toolkit for Linux
item.description: Powernux is a free, open-source PowerToys-style toolkit for Linux and GNOME: clipboard history, pinned windows, voice typing, an AI error assistant, focus mode and more — install only what you need.
